judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: Hero image of the White Week banner; it is the only content of a link to /uk/Christmas/c/all-christmas (tabindex=-1 but not aria-hidden, so screen readers still list it as a link). The link's computed name is the alt 'a woman in a white coat holding shopping bags in her hands'; the 'the WHITE WEEK 20% OFF everything' overlay is HTML text in a sibling div, outside the link, and the image file itself holds no text. Under 1.1.1's control clause and the test of H30 (applicable to 1.1.1), an image that is a link's only content needs a text alternative describing the link's purpose; this one only describes the photo. I looked for a pass: no aria-label on the link, and duplicate links elsewhere do not fix this one. The live CMS content still has this alt and imgUrl, so captureDiffers no. The claim names exactly this failure.
